transport.title: Metro to Lisbon
transport.text: The airport has a metro station: the Aeroporto — Saldanha line reaches central Lisbon in about 20 minutes. A reloadable electronic Navegante card can be purchased for EUR 0.50 for travel on the metro and Carris buses.

terminals.title: Terminal 2
terminals.text: Terminal 2 is for departures only and is closed from 00:30 to 03:30. A free bus runs to it from Terminal 1 from 03:30 to 00:30 the following day, departing from each terminal’s departures area every 12 minutes. The journey takes about 3 minutes.

kids.title: Family services
kids.text: Baby-changing rooms in Terminal 1 are in both public and restricted-access areas, with a sink, changing table and countertop. Terminal 1 has breastfeeding spaces in the public family room and after security near gate 15.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available at the airport with no time limit. Select _VINCI Airports WiFi, open a browser, accept the terms of use and press Connect.
